name: @clearbid/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Clearbid (common + identity + exchange domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle campaigns --output src/.bundled/campaigns.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle campaigns --output src/.bundled/campaigns.json && redocly bundle inventory --output src/.bundled/inventory.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle inventory --output src/.bundled/inventory.json && redocly bundle bidding --output src/.bundled/bidding.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle bidding --output src/.bundled/bidding.json && redocly bundle conversions --output src/.bundled/conversions.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle conversions --output src/.bundled/conversions.json && redocly bundle settlement --output src/.bundled/settlement.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle settlement --output src/.bundled/settlement.json && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.json && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.json
